unit.title: A proper apology
canDo: Give a cause using 由于 / 因为
Offer a consequence and repair with 因此
Keep an explanation separate from an excuse

grammar.explanation: 由于地址写错 can introduce a cause noun phrase or clause. 因为我写错地址 directly identifies an agent and cause. 由于 is often more written; do not use it to obscure responsibility. A cause can explain a delay without excusing it. This unit concerns an incorrect address, not a real accident.

examples.zh: 由于地址写错，朋友走错了地方。
examples.py: yóu yú dì zhǐ xiě cuò , péng you zǒu cuò le dì fāng .
examples.en: Because the address was wrong, the friend went to the wrong place.

examples.zh: 因为我写错地址，你多走了一段。
examples.py: yīn wèi wǒ xiě cuò dì zhǐ , nǐ duō zǒu le yī duàn .
examples.en: Because I wrote the wrong address, you travelled farther.

examples.zh: 因为没核对，我发了旧通知。
examples.py: yīn wèi méi hé duì , wǒ fā le jiù tōng zhī .
examples.en: Because I did not check, I sent the old notice.

commonMistakes.wrong: 由于你看了我写错的地址，所以是你的问题。
commonMistakes.right: 因为我写错地址，让你多走了一段，对不起。
commonMistakes.why: Name the actual cause without shifting responsibility.

grammar.purpose: Connect cause and consequence without inventing completion
grammar.explanation: 由于地址错了，因此需要发新地址 states a consequence and needed action, not proof that the new address has been sent. Compare 已经发送 with 现在要发送. 因此 is a concise written connector; 所以 is frequent conversationally. The consequence should follow from the stated cause, not from blame unrelated to the facts.

examples.zh: 地址错了，所以朋友多走了一段。
examples.py: dì zhǐ cuò le , suǒ yǐ péng you duō zǒu le yī duàn .
examples.en: The address was wrong, so the friend travelled farther.

examples.zh: 我漏了门牌号，因此现在补上。
examples.py: wǒ lòu le mén pái hào , yīn cǐ xiàn zài bǔ shàng .
examples.en: I omitted the building number, so I add it now.

examples.zh: 由于通知有错，所以先停止传播旧通知。
examples.py: yóu yú tōng zhī yǒu cuò , suǒ yǐ xiān tíng zhǐ chuán bō jiù tōng zhī .
examples.en: Because the notice is wrong, stop circulating the old one first.

commonMistakes.wrong: 需要补上，所以已经补好了。
commonMistakes.right: 需要补上，因此我现在补。
commonMistakes.why: A necessary repair is not evidence of a completed repair.

lines.zh: 我到门口了，怎么没看见你？
lines.py: wǒ dào mén kǒu le , zěn me méi kàn jiàn nǐ ?
lines.en: I'm at the entrance. Why can't I see you?
lines.speaker: a

lines.py: nǐ zài nǎ gè mén ? wǒ zài dōng mén .
lines.en: Which entrance? I'm at the east gate.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 你发的地址写西门，我在西门啊。
lines.py: nǐ fā de dì zhǐ xiě xī mén , wǒ zài xī mén a .
lines.en: The address you sent says west gate. That's where I am.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 对不起，我发了上次的地址，忘了改。
lines.py: duì bù qǐ , wǒ fā le shàng cì de dì zhǐ , wàng le gǎi .
lines.en: Sorry. I sent the previous address and forgot to change it.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 那我还要走多久？
lines.py: nà wǒ hái yào zǒu duō jiǔ ?
lines.en: How much farther do I have to walk?

lines.py: dà yuē shí fēn zhōng . wǒ guò qù jiē nǐ ba .

lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 好，我在西门旁边的小店等。
lines.py: hǎo , wǒ zài xī mén páng biān de xiǎo diàn děng .
lines.en: Okay. I'll wait at the little shop by the west gate.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 你先坐下，别在太阳底下等。
lines.py: nǐ xiān zuò xià , bié zài tài yáng dǐ xià děng .
lines.en: Have a seat. Don't wait in the sun.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 行。我还以为今天没有活动。
lines.py: xíng . wǒ hái yǐ wéi jīn tiān méi yǒu huó dòng .
lines.en: Okay. I thought there was no event today.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 有，是我发错了。新的地址已经发送给你。
lines.py: yǒu , shì wǒ fā cuò le . xīn de dì zhǐ yǐ jīng fā sòng gěi nǐ .
lines.en: There is. My mistake. I've sent you the new address.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 收到了，这次也有门口的照片。
lines.py: shōu dào le , zhè cì yě yǒu mén kǒu de zhào piān .
lines.en: Got it. There's a photo of the entrance too this time.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 对，我快到了，先给你买瓶水。
lines.py: duì , wǒ kuài dào le , xiān gěi nǐ mǎi píng shuǐ .
lines.en: Yes. I'm almost there. I'll get you a bottle of water first.
lines.speaker: b

reading.title: A cause and a responsibility
reading.blurb: An original scene written for this course.
reading.purpose: Follow the situation, the problem and what happens next.

lines.zh: 我按照陈宇发的地址到了西门，却没看见他。打电话才知道，他在东门，地址是上次的。他马上道歉，说忘了改。
lines.py: wǒ àn zhào chén yǔ fā de dì zhǐ dào le xī mén , què méi kàn jiàn tā . dǎ diàn huà cái zhī dào , tā zài dōng mén , dì zhǐ shì shàng cì de . tā mǎ shàng dào qiàn , shuō wàng le gǎi .
lines.en: I followed Chen Yu's address to the west gate but couldn't see him. On the phone I learnt he was at the east gate; he'd sent the previous address. He immediately apologised for forgetting to change it.

lines.zh: 从西门到东门大约十分钟，太阳又大。我问应该怎么走，他说先找地方坐下，他过来接我。我就在小店门口等。
lines.py: cóng xī mén dào dōng mén dà yuē shí fēn zhōng , tài yáng yòu dà . wǒ wèn yīng gāi zěn me zǒu , tā shuō xiān zhǎo dì fāng zuò xià , tā guò lái jiē wǒ . wǒ jiù zài xiǎo diàn mén kǒu děng .
lines.en: It was about ten minutes to the east gate, under a strong sun. I asked the way. He told me to find a seat and he'd come over, so I waited by the little shop.

lines.zh: 他给我发送了新地址和门口照片，我放大照片一看，上面挂着今天活动的名字。这才知道刚才找不到的原因。
lines.py: tā gěi wǒ fā sòng le xīn dì zhǐ hé mén kǒu zhào piān , wǒ fàng dà zhào piān yī kàn , shàng miàn guà zhe jīn tiān huó dòng de míng zi . zhè cái zhī dào gāng cái zhǎo bù dào de yuán yīn .
lines.en: He sent the new address and a photo of the entrance, showing today's event name. That explained why I hadn't been able to find it earlier.

lines.zh: 陈宇过来时，手上拿着两瓶水。他又说对不起，我说没事，先喝一口再走。他把另一瓶给我，带我从旁边的小路过去。
lines.py: chén yǔ guò lái shí , shǒu shàng ná zhe liǎng píng shuǐ . tā yòu shuō duì bù qǐ , wǒ shuō méi shì , xiān hē yī kǒu zài zǒu . tā bǎ lìng yī píng gěi wǒ , dài wǒ cóng páng biān de xiǎo lù guò qù .
lines.en: Chen Yu arrived with two bottles of water and apologised again. It was okay, I said; let's have a drink before walking. He handed me a bottle and led me along the little path.

lines.zh: 到东门以后，我们看见几个朋友也刚到。陈宇把新地址和照片一起发到群里，又问有没有人已经去了西门。
lines.py: dào dōng mén yǐ hòu , wǒ men kàn jiàn jǐ gè péng you yě gāng dào . chén yǔ bǎ xīn dì zhǐ hé zhào piān yì qǐ fā dào qún lǐ , yòu wèn yǒu méi yǒu rén yǐ jīng qù le xī mén .
lines.en: At the east gate some friends were arriving too. Chen Yu sent the new address and photo to the group and asked if anyone else had gone to the west gate.

lines.zh: 只有我走错了，大家都笑着说我替他们看过另一边。我说下次就让我发地址，陈宇说好，不过今天先进去，第一首歌已经开始了。
lines.py: zhǐ yǒu wǒ zǒu cuò le , dà jiā dōu xiào zhe shuō wǒ tì tā men kàn guò lìng yī biān . wǒ shuō xià cì jiù ràng wǒ fā dì zhǐ , chén yǔ shuō hǎo , bù guò jīn tiān xiān jìn qù , dì yī shǒu gē yǐ jīng kāi shǐ le .
lines.en: Only I'd gone to the wrong gate. Everyone joked that I'd checked the other side for them. Next time I'd send the address, I said. Okay, said Chen Yu, but let's go in now; the first song had begun.

lines.zh: 新闻正在报道那起事件。
lines.py: xīn wén zhèng zài bào dào nà qǐ shì jiàn .
lines.en: The news is reporting that incident.

lines.zh: 路口发生了交通事故。
lines.py: lù kǒu fā shēng le jiāo tōng shì gù .
lines.en: There was a traffic accident at the junction.

lines.zh: 那次事故以后，他开车更小心了。
lines.py: nà cì shì gù yǐ hòu , tā kāi chē gèng xiǎo xīn le .
lines.en: He's driven more carefully since that accident.

lines.zh: 忘了关冰箱门，后果就是东西都不凉了。
lines.py: wàng le guān bīng xiāng mén , hòu guǒ jiù shì dōng xi dōu bù liáng le .
lines.en: I forgot to shut the fridge, and everything stopped being cold.

lines.zh: 他没有想到这样做的后果。
lines.py: tā méi yǒu xiǎng dào zhè yàng zuò de hòu guǒ .
lines.en: He hadn't thought about the consequences.

lines.zh: 听到这个消息，她有什么反应？
lines.py: tīng dào zhè gè xiāo xī , tā yǒu shén me fǎn yìng ?
lines.en: How did she react to the news?

lines.zh: 他反应很快，一下就接住了杯子。
lines.py: tā fǎn yìng hěn kuài , yī xià jiù jiē zhù le bēi zi .
lines.en: He reacted quickly and caught the cup at once.

lines.zh: 我想用这张卡表达感谢。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng yòng zhè zhāng kǎ biǎo dá gǎn xiè .
lines.en: I'd like this card to express my thanks.

lines.zh: 你可以直接表达自己的想法。
lines.py: nǐ kě yǐ zhí jiē biǎo dá zì jǐ de xiǎng fǎ .
lines.en: You can express your thoughts directly.

lines.zh: 店里贴了一份退货声明。
lines.py: diàn lǐ tiē le yī fèn tuì huò shēng míng .
lines.en: The shop displayed a statement about returns.

lines.zh: 学校发表了关于停课的声明。
lines.py: xué xiào fā biǎo le guān yú tíng kè de shēng míng .
lines.en: The school issued a statement about class suspension.

lines.zh: 老师宣布明天不上课。
lines.py: lǎo shī xuān bù míng tiān bù shàng kè .
lines.en: The teacher announced there'd be no class tomorrow.

lines.zh: 他们宣布了比赛结果。
lines.py: tā men xuān bù le bǐ sài jié guǒ .
lines.en: They announced the competition results.

lines.zh: 照片我已经发送给你了。
lines.py: zhào piān wǒ yǐ jīng fā sòng gěi nǐ le .
lines.en: I've sent you the photos.

lines.zh: 发送之前，先看看地址对不对。
lines.py: fā sòng zhī qián , xiān kàn kàn dì zhǐ duì bú duì .
lines.en: Check the address before sending it.

lines.zh: 名字漏了，补上吧。
lines.py: míng zi lòu le , bǔ shàng ba .
lines.en: The name's missing. Add it.

lines.zh: 这个洞还能补吗？
lines.py: zhè gè dòng hái néng bǔ ma ?
lines.en: Can this hole still be mended?

lines.zh: 这份计划还需要完善。
lines.py: zhè fèn jì huà hái xū yào wán shàn .
lines.en: This plan still needs refinement.

lines.zh: 我想把房间里的设备完善一下。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng bǎ fáng jiān lǐ de shè bèi wán shàn yī xià .
lines.en: I'd like to improve the facilities in the room.

lines.zh: 过马路的时候注意车。
lines.py: guò mǎ lù de shí hou zhù yì chē .
lines.en: Watch for cars when crossing the road.

lines.zh: 注意看第二行，日期在那里。
lines.py: zhù yì kàn dì èr xíng , rì qī zài nà lǐ .
lines.en: Look carefully at the second line; that's where the date is.

lines.zh: 奇怪，杯子怎么不见了？
lines.py: qí guài , bēi zi zěn me bú jiàn le ?
lines.en: Strange. Where did the cup go?

lines.zh: 这句话听起来有点奇怪。
lines.py: zhè jù huà tīng qǐ lái yǒu diǎn qí guài .
lines.en: This sentence sounds a little odd.

lines.zh: 他没来，我有点伤心。
lines.py: tā méi lái , wǒ yǒu diǎn shāng xīn .
lines.en: I'm a little sad that he didn't come.

lines.zh: 看完电影，她还在伤心。
lines.py: kàn wán diàn yǐng , tā hái zài shāng xīn .
lines.en: She's still upset after watching the film.

lines.zh: 他腿上有一点伤。
lines.py: tā tuǐ shàng yǒu yī diǎn shāng .
lines.en: He has a small injury on his leg.

lines.zh: 这句话伤了她的心。
lines.py: zhè jù huà shāng le tā de xīn .
lines.en: This sentence hurt her feelings.

lines.zh: 搬家时，我失去了一些旧照片。
lines.py: bān jiā shí , wǒ shī qù le yī xiē jiù zhào piān .
lines.en: I lost some old photos during the move.

lines.zh: 我不想失去这个朋友。
lines.py: wǒ bù xiǎng shī qù zhè gè péng you .
lines.en: I don't want to lose this friend.

lines.zh: 猫一下就消失在门后了。
lines.py: māo yī xià jiù xiāo shī zài mén hòu le .
lines.en: The cat vanished behind the door.

lines.zh: 太阳消失在云里了。
lines.py: tài yáng xiāo shī zài yún lǐ le .
lines.en: The sun disappeared behind the clouds.

lines.zh: 谢谢你信任我。
lines.py: xiè xiè nǐ xìn rèn wǒ .
lines.en: Thank you for trusting me.

lines.zh: 我们一起工作多年，彼此很信任。
lines.py: wǒ men yì qǐ gōng zuò duō nián , bǐ cǐ hěn xìn rèn .
lines.en: We've worked together for years and trust each other.

lines.zh: 他很认真地对待这次比赛。
lines.py: tā hěn rèn zhēn de duì dài zhè cì bǐ sài .
lines.en: He takes this competition seriously.

lines.zh: 你怎么对待新来的同学？
lines.py: nǐ zěn me duì dài xīn lái de tóng xué ?
lines.en: How do you treat the new classmate?

lines.zh: 我把相关的照片放在一起了。
lines.py: wǒ bǎ xiāng guān de zhào piān fàng zài yì qǐ le .
lines.en: I've put the related photos together.

lines.zh: 这件事和昨天的问题相关。
lines.py: zhè jiàn shì hé zuó tiān de wèn tí xiāng guān .
lines.en: This is connected to yesterday's problem.

No identity, copyright or assessment-policy lecture inside ordinary speech. All 88 word records retain IDs and get two independent contexts; abstract/formal senses use suitable separate sentences.
